blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateGiftCardRedeemStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that a gift card can be redeemed. It throws an error if the
gift card is already redeemed or already has an associated store credit account.

children.name: ValidateGiftCardRedeemStepInput
children.description: Input to validate that a gift card is eligible for redemption.
